text:
I could not confirm any award *Avatar: The Last Airbender* won in 2006. The wins I found are dated 2007 (the 34th Annie Awards, and a Primetime Emmy for Sangjin Kim's "Lake Logai" work), and the shared note's claim of a 2006 voice-cast win isn't supported by any source I found. Sources: [Wikipedia, season 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar:_The_Last_Airbender_season_2) and [Emmys.com 2007 short-format animated nominees](https://www.emmys.com/awards/nominees-winners/2007/outstanding-short-format-animated-program).

CONFIDENCE: 20
